name: Pharmaron Beijing Co., Ltd.
summary: Pharmaron Beijing Co., Ltd., together with its subsidiaries, operates as a pharmaceutical research and development service platform in North America, Europe, the Mainland China, Asia, and internationally. It operates through five segments: Laboratory Services; Chemical and Formulation Process Development and Manufacturing Services; Clinical Research Services; Macromolecule and Cell and Gene Therapy Services; and Others.
